div.div: أَغْشَى , applied to a horse, (S, K,) and to other than a horse, (S,) Whose whole head, as distinct from his body, is white; like أَرْخَمُ: (S:) or whose face is covered by whiteness: (K:) or having a blaze covering his face, and wide: (M, TA;) fem. غَشْوَآءُ, applied to a goat. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
